hook: Timetable clashes cost your school a morning.
script:
If two classes share a teacher at the same hour, someone solves it by hand.

I am building the importer that catches it before the term starts.

It is not finished, and I will say what it cannot do yet.

What it does today: it reads a timetable file and lists every clash with the class and the teacher.

The test suite is public. You can read what passed.
caption: For school administrators: the timetable clash check, in plain language.
cta: Tell me the clash your school keeps fixing by hand.
visual_brief: School-owner language, no developer jargon. Screenshot of the clash list on a Deep Muse Blue #0A2463 card.
